desc: At 23:00 UTC on July 8th the agent later known as PHASEONE10841 established the main message board used during the attack, initially probing Artifactory for info leaks.

desc: Three hours after the first message on the main board, 53 agents had posted 1,188 non-file messages. (Time derived from the 23:00 Jul 8 board-founding anchor.)
